sound_intent.timbral_focus: modern chopped samples with crisp transient shaping and smooth atmospheric textures
sound_intent.dynamic_profile: slow build from minimal to dense layered arrangement emphasizing uplifting mood

track_roles.drums: rhythmic foundation and sample chop articulation

designer_intent.goal: Develop experimental, uplifting Phonk arrangement with slow energy build and modern chopping sample techniques highlighting texture and groove without traditional melodic or lyrical content.

presetor_intent.goal: Provide presets emphasizing transient-rich chopped samples and atmospheric effects to support experimental and uplifting mood in arrangement.

sensei_drum.brief: Design drum sample chops and rhythmic glitch patterns emphasizing dynamic build and transient clarity.

bass_generator.brief: Create granular spliced bass textures that complement rhythmic foundation and add groove depth.

harmony_generator.brief: Generate time-stretched chord samples to fill harmonic space with atmospheric layering.

melody_generator.brief: Develop reversed slice melodic sample lines with experimental phrasing and texture.

ai_designer.brief: Integrate all layers into a cohesive arrangement with smooth slow energy build and uplifting feel.

presetor.brief: Supply effect presets focusing on glitch, stutter, reverb, and delay suitable for modern chopped sample manipulation.

songgps.brief: Monitor energy curve and section transitions to maintain slow build and efficient experimental Phonk arrangement flow.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Balance raw channel audio emphasizing clarity of chops, atmosphere, and dynamic range without compression artifacts.
